title: Great tool!
body:
I am really thankful for all these years of using this app. However there are a few issues I am still struggling with

1) the location is often not applicable or easy to add. I wish there was an option to add a link, place a marker, or just better search of a street… even pick up from maps or a contact.

2) though I love the feature of notes, and even enjoy a new reminder/calendar event that has the note, I think its silly that every time I add an event it brings up the same note, from 2 years ago, which I have to manually delete every time. I made an event called “arranged meeting” and there was a note…. Now everytime I add to my calendar, and select the same title it brings the same note… this should not happen… i’ve had over 20 “arrange meeting” events without a note… pick it up from my last one.
